spans.s:
adhaḥkāyaḥ अधःकायः
Lower half of the body
The lower half of the body, below the waist.

ITA-5.55.6 avakṣipta-sandhimuktam/ adhaḥkṣiptasandhimuktam अवक्षिप्त-सन्धिमुक्तम्/ अधःक्षिप्त-सन्धिमुक्तम्
Dislocation with downward displacement
A dislocation characterized by loosening or dislocation of joints; severe joint pain.

adhaḥpātanam अधःपातनम्
Downward distillation of mercury

ITA-2.5.5 adhaḥsrotaḥ अधःस्रोतः
Anal or urethral passage
Passages in the lower part of the body leading to the exterior.

ITA-3.7.26 adharatrikam अधरत्रिकम्
Sacral region, sacrum

adharamārgaḥ अधरमार्गः
Lower passages
The common term for the anal, urethral and vaginal passages.

.7 adharaḥ, adharauṣṭhaḥ अधरः, अधरौष्ठः
Lower lip

ITA-2.7.3 adhāraṇīya-vegaḥ अधारणीयवेगः
Non-suppressible urges
The natural urges of the body which should not be curbed or inhibited, i.e. passage of urine, stools, semen, vomiting, sneezing, burping, yawning, hunger, thirst, tears, sleep and breath. Their inhibition results in a multitude of disorders.
